nodes.title: 1. Model Loading & Patching
widgets_values:
### 1. Model Loading & Patching
Loads the Pixal3D/TRELLIS2 pipeline and the preprocessing models used by the geometry branch.

- `Orbit3DLoadModel` loads **TencentARC/Pixal3D with its MV denoisers**.
- Qwen-Image-Edit + VAE are patched with separate Marigold V2 normal/depth LoRAs.
- MoGe-3 is loaded once and reused for every selected view.

The Orbit pipeline is based on **visualbruno/ComfyUI-Trellis2**; see the package README / `UPSTREAM.md` for provenance.

nodes.title: 2. Task Configuration
widgets_values:
### 2. Task Configuration
`Yaw/Pitch Angle Grid` is the single source of requested camera angles.

- `yaw_step=15` → 24 views around the Y axis.
- Keep **`pitch_step=360`** for the verified yaw-only workflow.
- `azimuths` drives both **VGGT target_angles** and **MultiView Config**.
- `elevations` drives MultiView Config.
- Select your full 360° turntable video in `Load Video`.

Changing yaw density here automatically keeps frame selection and reconstruction camera metadata synchronized.

nodes.title: 3. Frame Selection & Preparation
widgets_values:
### 3. Frame Selection & Preparation
1. RMBG creates a clean subject cutout.
2. Choose rotate directions in VGGT node
3. VGGT estimates the camera orbit and chooses the frames closest to the requested yaw angles.
4. Cyclic RealBasicVSR upscales the exact selected source frames while preserving their order.

`0°` is always the **first video frame**. Set `clockwise` to match the object's temporal rotation direction.

nodes.title: 4. Geometry / Normals / Depth / Render Preparation
widgets_values:
### 4. Geometry / Normals / Depth / Render Preparation
The selected views are padded/recomposed consistently, then processed per view:

- **Marigold V2 normals** → native camera-space surface normals.
- **Marigold V2 depth** → auxiliary depth map.
- **MoGe-3** → points, depth, normals, mask and intrinsics in one geometry packet.
- Clay render combines appearance/geometry cues used by the current reconstruction workflow.

List outputs are reassembled into ordered batches. `Orbit3DMultiViewConfig` validates counts/order, attaches FOV + yaw/elevation metadata, and emits `PIXAL3D_MV_VIEWS`.

nodes.title: 5. 3D Mesh Generation
widgets_values:
### 5. 3D Mesh Generation
Orbit executes the retained Pixal3D MV reconstruction path:

**Sparse Structure → Shape512 → ShapeHR/Cascade → Decode → Mesh reconstruction**

The tested configuration uses anchored soft occlusion, S4 bridge repair, geometry-aware weighted conditioning, Marigold normals + MoGe depth, and native-resolution DINO detail tiles.

This example contains only the active reconstruction path used to produce the printable mesh; diagnostic exporters are intentionally omitted.

nodes.title: 6. Output
widgets_values:
### 6. Output
The active path converts the decoded mesh to `TRIMESH`, exports it as **PLY**, and sends the exported file to `Preview3D` for a quick visual inspection.

The example is intentionally focused on **3D-printing geometry**. Optional CGI-oriented cleanup / simplification branches are omitted; any print-specific repair or sculpt cleanup can be performed downstream in the user's preferred mesh tooling.

nodes.title: Required Models / Storage Locations
widgets_values:
# Required models / storage locations

The example assumes the following files/paths. Some Orbit/Pixal3D assets are downloaded automatically by the loader; the other preprocessing nodes expect standard ComfyUI model folders.

```text
ComfyUI/
├── models/
│   ├── TencentARC/Pixal3D/                         # auto-downloaded by Orbit3DLoadModel
│   ├── facebook/dinov3-vitl16-pretrain-lvd1689m/  # auto-downloaded by Orbit loader
│   ├── microsoft/TRELLIS-image-large/ckpts/        # sparse decoder support; auto if missing
│   ├── unet/
│   │   └── Qwen-Image-Edit-2509-Q4_K_M.gguf
│   ├── vae/
│   │   └── qwen_image_vae.safetensors
│   ├── loras/
│   │   ├── marigold-v2-normals.safetensors
│   │   └── marigold-v2-depth-Log-stage2.safetensors
│   ├── geometry_estimation/
│   │   └── moge_3_vitg_fp16.safetensors
│   ├── RMBG/RMBG-2.0/
│   │   └── model.safetensors                       # RMBG node may auto-download its full model set
│   └── video_sr/realbasicvsr/
│       └── realbasicvsr_c64b20_1x30x8_lr5e-5_150k_reds_20211104-52f77c2c.pth
```

VGGT-Ω lives outside the normal ComfyUI model tree in this example:

```text
~/vggt-omega/                                      # facebookresearch/vggt-omega checkout
└── checkpoints/VGGT-Omega-1B-512/
    └── vggt_omega_1b_512.pt
```

Useful sources:
- Orbit upstream basis: https://github.com/visualbruno/ComfyUI-Trellis2
- Marigold V2 nodes: https://github.com/visualbruno/ComfyUI-Marigold-v2
- VGGT-Ω: https://github.com/facebookresearch/vggt-omega
- RealBasicVSR: https://github.com/ckkelvinchan/RealBasicVSR
- ComfyUI-GGUF: https://github.com/city96/ComfyUI-GGUF

**Input:** replace `turntable.mp4` in the Load Video node with your own full turntable sequence.
